system_description.narrative_title: French unrest triggers eurozone bond stress and political spillovers
system_description.narrative_summary: Widespread protests and violent unrest in France are driving a sharp repricing of French sovereign debt and wider eurozone bond markets, while damaging consumer-facing firms and provoking heavy-handed political responses. The situation functions as an open system: flows of capital, information (including disinformation), policy measures and social grievance interact through reinforcing feedbacks—rising yields worsen government financing and banking risk, which amplifies political instability and investor flight. Cross-border transmissions (investor reallocations, election polling shifts, and contagion to other European protests) turn a national crisis into a regional financial‑political event.
system_description.scope: Inside the system boundary: French social unrest and protests, domestic security and political responses (curfews, troop deployments, anti-riot laws), French sovereign bond yields and spreads, eurozone sovereign debt and bank-sovereign linkages, investor safe‑haven flows (Treasuries, FX), corporate impacts on French retailers/luxury firms and insurers, media and disinformation campaigns, and short-term election/political polling dynamics.
system_description.super_system: Global financial markets and geopolitical-risk complex (global capital flows, sovereign debt markets, and international political dynamics)
adjacent_subsystems: Eurozone sovereign debt and banking sector (spreads, doom-loop dynamics)
European domestic politics and elections (rise of populist/far-right forces, protest movements)
Global safe-haven markets and US Treasuries (capital flight, yield shifts)
Corporate sector exposure and insurance/real-economy transmission (retail, luxury, logistics)
evidence_headlines: French 10-year bond yield hits 5% for first time since 2002 amid unrest
French supermarket giant's shares plunge 14% after warning ‘unprecedented’ unrest will hit business
French bond sell-off intensifies after riots and looting
France to deploy troops, admits to failures over weekend unrest
Bond selloff revives debate about euro zone banks' 'doom loop'
Prediction-market odds rise for Marine Le Pen in France 2027 presidential race as protests roil nation

variables.name: Social unrest intensity
variables.description: Measures the aggregate frequency, scale and violence level of public protests and civil disorder.

variables.name: Security response level
variables.description: Measures the intensity and restrictiveness of public‑order measures such as curfews, troop deployments and emergency policing.

variables.name: Sovereign bond yields
variables.description: Measures the prevailing long‑term nominal interest rate demanded by investors on government debt.

variables.name: Sovereign spread
variables.description: Measures the yield premium of a given sovereign's debt over a benchmark sovereign or reference rate.

variables.name: Banking solvency risk
variables.description: Measures the probability and expected magnitude of capital shortfalls across the banking sector due to asset losses or funding stress.

variables.name: Capital outflow rate
variables.description: Measures the net rate at which financial capital is withdrawn from domestic assets and transferred abroad.

variables.name: Safe‑haven demand
variables.description: Measures the net flow of investor demand into assets perceived as safe stores of value (e.g., high‑quality sovereigns, safe currencies).

variables.name: Market volatility
variables.description: Measures the realised or expected short‑term price variability across financial markets (bonds, equities, FX).

variables.name: Currency pressure rate
variables.description: Measures the rate of depreciation/appreciation pressure on a currency driven by capital flows and market sentiment.

variables.name: Corporate disruption level
variables.description: Measures the extent of operational, revenue and asset disruptions experienced by consumer‑facing firms due to unrest and security measures.

variables.name: Insurer loss exposure
variables.description: Measures the expected scale of insurance claims and balance‑sheet losses arising from property damage, business interruption and liability related to unrest.

variables.name: Disinformation prevalence
variables.description: Measures the volume and reach of false or manipulative information circulating through media and social channels.

variables.name: Political polarization
variables.description: Measures the degree of ideological and affective division within the polity and among political actors.

variables.name: Cross‑border contagion tendency
variables.description: Measures the propensity for social unrest, political shifts or financial stress to transmit from one jurisdiction to others.

variables.name: Fiscal financing pressure
variables.description: Measures the difficulty and cost profile of government debt rollover and fiscal funding needs relative to fiscal capacity.

variables.name: Information transparency
variables.description: Measures the openness and reliability of official and market information available to the public and investors.

catalysts.title: Fresh weekend unrest in France
catalysts.description: Anticipated renewed protests and clashes across French cities over the coming weekend as authorities brace for demonstrations following ongoing riots.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'France to deploy military as it braces for fresh unrest this weekend'; ongoing riot coverage.

catalysts.title: French military deployment to support policing
catalysts.description: Short‑term deployment of troops to support domestic security operations, announced as authorities respond to riots and looting.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'France to deploy military as it braces for fresh unrest this weekend' and 'France to deploy troops, admits to failures...'

catalysts.title: Expanded protest bans and curfews in France
catalysts.description: Government moves to ban some protests and extend curfews in targeted cities, tightening restrictions on public gatherings.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Macron warns some protests will be banned' and 'France extends curfews in some cities...'

catalysts.title: EU probe into pro‑Kremlin disinformation
catalysts.description: European Commission/authorities investigate and counter pro‑Kremlin amplification of unrest narratives, with potential takedowns or sanctions.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'EU probes pro‑Kremlin disinformation around French riots'.

catalysts.title: French sovereign bond auctions and refinancing stress
catalysts.description: Scheduled French debt auctions and upcoming refinancing needs will test investor demand amid elevated yields and outflows.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'French 10‑year bond yield hits 5%...', 'France’s Debt Crisis Deepens...' and 'Treasury Auctions Explained...'.

catalysts.title: Continued flight to US Treasuries / safe havens
catalysts.description: Investors shift into US Treasuries and other safe assets, drawing demand away from eurozone sovereigns and increasing spreads.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'U.S. 10‑Year Treasury Yield Falls... as French Turmoil Fuels Flight for Safety' and related coverage.

catalysts.title: Far‑right momentum ahead of 2027 French election
catalysts.description: Rising prediction‑market odds and political traction for far‑right candidates as unrest reshapes the pre‑electoral landscape through next year's vote.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Prediction‑market odds rise for Marine Le Pen in France 2027 presidential race as protests roil nation'.

catalysts.title: Insurer claims and reinsurance pressure from riots
catalysts.description: Rising property, business‑interruption and liability claims from looting and violence prompt insurer loss assessments and reinsurance market stress.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Insurers face losses as riots in France become ‘like natural catastrophes’' and reports of retail looting.
